$comment: Single source of truth for the canonical maze palette. Run `just generate-palette` after editing — both Sol and TS sides regenerate from this file. CI's `just verify-palette` re-runs codegen and asserts no diff.

fields.name: wall
fields.doc: Wall stroke color. Dark, moderately saturated; legible on every bg.

fields.name: mazeBg
fields.doc: Maze background. Soft, lightly saturated complement to walls.

fields.name: textBg
fields.doc: Embedded-text cell fill. Vibrant complement so letters jump out.

fields.name: zkBg
fields.doc: Z/K letter highlight. Triadic offset (textBg + 120) for harmony.

fields.name: crownBg
fields.doc: Crown emoji cell highlight. Always gold, regardless of seed.

fields.name: player
fields.doc: Live-canvas player glyph. Frontend-only — Sol no longer renders entities (ma-e7r).
